mods.title: VS IMPOSTOR: LEGACY
mods.description: VS IMPOSTOR IS BACK!A from-the-ground-up remaster of the 2023 mod, VS IMPOSTOR V4! VS IMPOSTOR: LEGACY intends to be faithful to the original experience, while introducing new tweaks and features to make it the definitive version of the mod you know and love!VS IMPOSTOR is a total-conversion mod for Friday Night Funkin', in which you face off against colorful Among Us characters. With over 10 weeks and 57 songs! this mod has plenty of content for you to explore, especially with brand-new awards and cosmetics for you to find and collect! And who knows? maybe there are more secrets to discover...OPTIMIZATIONTHE MOD IS ACTUALLY OPTIMIZED NOW... here's a little comparison of Danger alone... although in the real v4 nothing ever unloaded from your memory so by the time you'd get to danger on a fresh playthrough it'd probably be more like 4gigsLANGUAGEThis time around, the mod's not only in English! We've brought members of the community together and have translated the mod into 28 languages!EXPANDED COSMICUBE!Legacy's Cosmicube has been heavily expanded compared to the original from 2023. With tons of new skins and pets to find, you'll have a lot more to find and discover!AWARDSThere are 28 new awards for you to unlock! Will you get them all?BRAND-NEW DLC!With 5 new songs, and an entirely new Cosmicube, the SECURITY DLC will be made available when Legacy launches on April 25th!To install, just drag and drop the "securitydlc" folder into the content folderStill need help? mods.title: VS Cream the Rabbit V3
mods.description: Vs Cream the Rabbit V3Thank you for downloading Vs Cream the Rabbit V3!This mod is the result of a lot of hard work, dedication, and love. In this adventure, we'll be playing as different characters from the Sonic universe as they face off in fun-filled rap battles!What's the story?It all begins when Tails discovers that a meteor shower is going to take place soon. After looking into it, the friends find out that the best place to watch it is Floral Forest Village, the home of Cream, Cheese, and Vanilla. So, they decide to have a picnic there and enjoy the beautiful night sky together!But there's still some time before nightfall... and what better way to pass the time than with a few rap battles?About the projectThis mod aims to tell small, fun stories set in the Sonic universe, exploring different situations and moments with these beloved characters.Although we still have a long way to go before reaching the full release, this version is another step toward our goal.We hope to grow our team over time, bring more ideas to life, and take this project to its full potential, creating something different, special, and spectacular for the community.On behalf of the team, thank you so much for your support!Best wishes and lots of hugs! We hope you enjoy this little adventure!- EmmAMT
